streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Homogeneous solution of all reagents and solvent. Concentration matches batch (0.2 M). Flow rate derived from calculation to achieve target residence time.

mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: All components can be mixed simultaneously in acetic acid. Single stream feed implies pre-mixing or single pump inlet.
pre_reactor_steps: Degas acetic acid solvent with N2 sparging to remove dissolved O2, as DMF-DMA is moisture/oxygen sensitive per Chemistry Plan.
post_reactor_steps: Collect effluent directly; no quench required per Chemistry Plan.
chemistry_notes: Knoevenagel condensation of methyl 4-methoxyacetoacetate with DMF-DMA in acetic acid. Thermal reaction at 80°C. Single stream feed used for simplicity. Residence time reduced from 60 min (batch) to 6 min (flow) based on kinetic intensification factor of 10x. Axial dispersion (Pe=69) is significant but acceptable for this condensation. No BPR required as T=80°C is below acetic acid bp (118°C) with sufficient margin.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculation Step 2 estimated 6.0 min (10x intensification). Analogy 2 used 9 min for similar Knoevenagel at RT; our T=80°C allows faster kinetics. 6 min is within calculated range [4.0-85.3] min.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Single-phase liquid system. Basis is liquid volume / liquid flow.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Same as batch (80°C) per Chemistry Plan and Batch Input. Analogy 1 used 250°C but was SNAr; Analogy 2 used 25°C but was RT Knoevenagel. 80°C is optimal for this specific substrate/solvent pair.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation Step 8: BPR not required. Acetic acid bp ~118°C. Operating at 80°C provides >20°C margin. No gas generation.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA selected for thermal stability at 80°C and chemical resistance to acetic acid. FEP is also acceptable but PFA has higher temp rating. SS not required as no high pressure/corrosive halides.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: 0.2 M from Batch Input and Chemistry Plan. Analogy 2 used 0.25 M; 0.2 M is conservative and matches batch success.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Calculated as V = t * Q = 6.0 min * 0.5 mL/min = 3.0 mL. Matches Calculation Step 3.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: 1.0 mm from Calculation Step 3. Provides Pe=69. Smaller ID would improve Pe but increase pressure drop; 1.0 mm is standard for this flow rate.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: 0.5 mL/min derived from V=3.0 mL and t=6.0 min. Matches Calculation Step 3.
